sentences.text:
Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8245 of 2023
Applicant :- Ayushi Agrawal

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ravi Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No. 120 of 2017, under Sections 420, 409, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C., & 3,4,5,6 Prize Chits & Money Circulation Schemes (Banning) Act 1978, P.S. Babugarh, District Hapur, during pendency of the trial.

entities.text: Prize Chits & Money Circulation Schemes (Banning) Act 1978
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is lady and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to enmity; as per F.I.R., there is allegation of cheating and criminal breach of trust against the applicant.

It has next been argued that the applicant is not personally liable for the alleged offence of the company; the company has not been implicated;
co-accused, who was director of the company, has been granted bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 12.07.2022 passed in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.25949 of 2022.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.25949 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:

entities.text: Ayushi Agrawal vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Moreover, there is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 26.12.2017 and in case she is enlarged on bail she will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the mandate laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Dataram Singh Vs. State of U.P. and another reported in (2018) 3 SCC 22, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Dataram Singh Vs. State of U.P. and another reported in (2018) 3 SCC 22
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Ayushi Agrawal, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 22.3.2023 Meenu Singh  Ayushi Agrawal vs State Of U.P. on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55078753/
